# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Glyph and Vulkan reliability**

## Highlights

The unreleased 4.159.0 changes improve mask-filtered glyph rendering and handle specific Vulkan allocation failures on Imagination drivers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Mask-filtered glyph rendering corrected** — When successive loads from a stateful font scaler disagree about a glyph's path, format, or bounds, rendering now uses the reloaded glyph and clears incompatible masks instead of overflowing sub-byte rows. Clipped embossed glyphs also use full plane strides when copying mask data. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
- **Imagination Vulkan allocation failures handled** — Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools after descriptor-set allocation reports host or device out-of-memory on Imagination drivers, avoiding a driver failure during pool destruction. Graphite also prevents further allocation through the abandoned handle; other vendors and allocation errors are unaffected by this workaround. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
